name: Albright Metals Ltd
summary: Albright Metals Ltd engages in the exploration and development of mineral properties in Australia and the United States. It primarily explores for borates and lithium deposits. The company's principal project is the 100% owned Fort Cady project located in Southern California. The company was formerly known as American Pacific Borate & Lithium Limited and changed its name to Albright Metals Ltd in October 2019. Albright Metals Ltd was incorporated in 2016 and is based in Perth, Australia.
